def factor_momentum_volume_persistence(df):
    """Momentum signal weighted by volume surge and directional persistence."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1.0
    up_days = (df_copy["close"].diff() > 0).astype(float)
    persistence = up_days.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    raw_signal = momentum * persistence * vol_ratio
    df_copy["factor_momentum_volume_persistence"] = raw_signal
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_volume_persistence"]
description: Multi-day momentum (20-day return) is amplified by directional persistence (fraction of up days in the same window) and volume surge (vol_ratio from classify_volume_regime). The mechanism captures directional persistence: stocks with strong upward price moves, consistent up days, and elevated volume are likely to continue trending.
